mapper.select: SELECT u_no, u_id, u_name, u_tel, u_email FROM users ORDER BY u_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(u_no, u_id, u_passwd, u_name, u_tel, u_addr, u_zipno, u_email, u_auth, u_date, u_stats) VALUES(users_seq.nextval, #{u_id}, #{u_passwd}, #{u_name}, #{u_tel}, #{u_addr}, #{u_zipno}, #{u_email}, 'USER', SYSDATE, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET u_passwd = #{u_passwd}, u_tel = #{u_tel}, u_addr = #{u_addr}, u_zipno = #{u_zipno}, u_email = #{u_email} WHERE u_id = #{u_id}
